lead: Saturday's practical headline was small but real: [Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md when there is no CLAUDE.md](../summaries/7471c7d5ef4e.md). Around it, a security cluster - [a heap overflow and SSO misconfiguration compromising OpenAI internal repos](../summaries/4f60b8959b83.md) and [a US military close call over a hallucinated intelligence report](../summaries/d9044257d7d1.md) - plus a burst of small-model releases: [Qwen-Image-2.1](../summaries/168311a32c68.md), [Cactus Needle 3's 8-29MB automation models](../summaries/307dafbc9d60.md) and [Alibaba's cancer-detecting open model](../summaries/9f8b7cbac08b.md).

sections.title: Small models, big claims
sections.intro: Compact image generation, megabyte-scale automation models matching much larger systems, and an open model screening for ~150 conditions.

sections.title: Security weekend
sections.intro: Compromised internal repos, a hallucinated intelligence report nearly used by the military, a re-reading of the Hugging Face hack, and 'Pirate Face' rescuing deleted models.

sections.title: Persuasion and perception
sections.intro: Chatbots that change minds, a test of whether you can spot AI images, the destruction of Creative Commons, and DraftKings targeting the gamblers likeliest to lose.

sections.title: The tooling keeps compounding
sections.intro: AGENTS.md support, a chief-of-staff pattern for orchestrating agents, Microsoft porting Copilot's runtime to Rust agentically for $120K, and weekend builds in Zig and search.

sections.title: Society absorbs the shock
sections.intro: AI in schools, interviewing devs post-AI, an antitrust suit over an alleged slowdown pact, and the web's 'doom loop'.
